title: Chapter 133 The Past
content:
Chapter 133 The Past

Instantly, Tiandao understood the horror of the man in front of him.

With this kind of strength, it should be more than enough to face that level of cause and effect.

Then, Tiandao did not hesitate any longer and began to speak slowly.

Everything about Yan Lingyun in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Those things happened a long, long time ago.

That day, the void was broken, and a terrifying breath rushed directly into the Wood Immortal Realm from it.

But her breath was extremely weak, and she looked seriously injured.

"Girl, you don't belong here."

Tiandao came to the woman and said nervously.

The woman was none other than Yan Lingyun, but Yan Lingyun was in a very bad state at the moment, but even so, Yan Lingyun still said toughly: "Why, do you still want to drive me away?"

Looking at Yan Lingyun, Tiandao was silent.

Of course, he couldn't drive her away. He didn't want to get involved, and he didn't have the strength, but if he let the other party stay in the Wood Immortal Realm, it would definitely affect the entire Wood Immortal Realm.

All he wanted was to protect himself.

As if he had seen what Tiandao was thinking, Yan Lingyun took a deep breath and said slowly: "I will leave after my injury is healed."

Hearing this, Tiandao said: "What if something unexpected happens?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun had already closed her eyes.

Seeing this, Tiandao had no choice but to leave.

In addition to admitting his bad luck, he had nothing else to say.

Although he was not as strong as Yan Lingyun, he could see that Yan Lingyun was a strong man from a higher plane, and any force behind him was enough to destroy the entire Wood Immortal Realm.

Next, he could only pray that Yan Lingyun would leave the Wood Immortal Realm as soon as possible, or that the other party would not be too cruel when he attacked.

And for a long time afterwards, the Wood Immortal Realm was safe and sound, and everything was the same as before.

But Yan Lingyun's injury did not improve at all, but continued to decline.

Now, Yan Lingyun's strength has dropped to the Immortal Emperor Realm.

He became an extremely mysterious and powerful existence in the Wood Immortal Realm. The world only knew that his strength was terrifying, several times more terrifying than that of an ordinary Immortal Emperor, but the world knew nothing about his origin.

Unfortunately, the peace was only short-lived.

That day, the void was broken.

Just like the first time Yan Lingyun came to the Wood Immortal Realm.

A terrifying force broke through the void and came straight towards Yan Lingyun.

Looking at the terrifying force, Tiandao was terrified, but still relieved. This force was only aimed at one person. Although it might have some impact on the Wood Immortal Realm, it was not a big problem after all.

Then, Tiandao looked at a certain place in the Wood Immortal Realm, and saw Yan Lingyun looking at the force rushing towards him with a destructive aura with a calm expression. It seemed that he had already expected it, and there was no fear in his eyes.

There was only a touch of unwillingness and anger.

"Wait, I will be back."

Boom!

With a thunderous roar, Yan Lingyun's figure completely disappeared in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Looking at the blurred image in front of Tiandao, Lu Daosheng remained silent.

Is this what his wife experienced in the Wood Immortal Realm?

It is exactly the same as what he deduced.

Obviously, Yan Lingyun has more terrifying enemies in a higher plane.

Even his wife can't resist it.

However, with Lu Daosheng's eyesight, he naturally saw some clues.

At the last moment, Yan Lingyun's body burst into a faint light.

Treasure!

That unknown thing protected a trace of Yan Lingyun's soul.

In this way, Yan Lingyun successfully reborn in the lower world.

This is simply the template of the protagonist!

"System, how many lives has my wife been in?"

[Three Lives]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly, which was also what he guessed.

Long before, he had deduced the life experience of his wife. She was the Supreme God who had gone alone to the unknown star field countless years ago!

In that era, Yan Lingyun was invincible in time and was crowned as the Supreme God, representing the ultimate of God!

Then, I don’t know what happened, the Supreme God went alone to the unknown star field.

A terrible war broke out instantly.

Huge fluctuations spread throughout the heavens and lasted for more than ten years before it ended.

No one knows the ending, but the Supreme God never came out of the unknown star field again.

At that moment, the world knew one thing.

The invincible Supreme God died in the unknown star field.

And from that moment on, the unknown star field completely became a life forbidden zone.

No one dared to set foot in it anymore, and couldn’t even get close.

But Lu Daosheng knew that his wife did not die in the unknown star field, but was unable to completely solve the evil race that was ready to move in the unknown star field. In the end, she had no choice but to be reborn again at the cost of severely damaging the entire race of the other party.

In the end, there is no doubt that Yan Lingyun was reborn again.

Reborn in the Phoenix Clan of the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

This time, Yan Lingyun's birth was not optimistic. Before Yan Lingyun awakened her past life memories, she was directly exiled to a small world by the Phoenix Clan.

And it was because of this experience that Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun met.

At that time, Yan Lingyun was not a supreme god, nor was she an extremely terrifying peerless strongman, but just a little girl abandoned by her family and relatives.

Even so, Yan Lingyun still maintained her strong character.

It was a dark and windy night.

Yan Lingyun was walking alone on the road.

At this moment, several big men suddenly jumped out from the bushes on the roadside, and then looked at Yan Lingyun with a lewd smile.

"Hehehe, little girl, robbery."

Looking at the strong men in front of her, Yan Lingyun did not have a trace of fear, but raised her eyebrows and said: "Robbery?"

The leading big man nodded and smiled: "Yes, we not only rob money, hehe, but also rob women."

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun shook her head.

A few little minions who can only write three-legged cat kung fu, naturally I don't take it seriously.

Just when I was about to take action, a strong smell of alcohol suddenly floated from a distance.

"Stop, stop!"

I saw a young man with a bottle of wine in his hand and a red face staggering over from a distance.

"You dare to tease a beautiful woman in broad daylight!"

Although the boy was a little drunk, he still shouted at the big men in the distance.

Looking at the boy in front of him who was protecting her, Yan Lingyun felt a little touched for the first time.

At this time, the boy looked back and smiled: "Don't be afraid, beautiful woman, I'm here, nothing will happen."

In the distance, the big man in the lead sneered: "Boy, what are you shouting about? This is not in broad daylight, but late at night."

Hearing this, the other big men burst into laughter.

Obviously, no one took the drunk boy seriously.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun glared at the big men coldly, and then said to the boy in a low voice: "Don't be impulsive, let me do it myself."

Hearing this, the boy frowned and said: "A real man, how can I let a girl do it, I'll do it!"

As soon as the voice fell, the boy clenched his fists and rushed directly towards the big men.
